# dsh-activity-view

An activity view for the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar. A bell sits in the
sessions header, between t

he view options and the add-project button. Click it
to swap the session list for three groups:
| Group | A session shows here when |
| **Needs attention** | it finished while you looked elsewhere (unread), or it waits for an approval

, a plan review or an answer |
| **Working** | it is running |
| **Today** | its last activity was t
oday (local calendar day) |
Left: the default sessions list. Right: the activity view, bell on.

Blank, subagent and archived sessions stay out. Unread rows get the green dot,
waiting rows the oran

ge one, working rows the native spinner. The bell itself
shows a dot when anything needs attention,
also while the view is off.

The bell is the only switch. The choice is stored in the browser under the
`dsh-activity-view.v2` lo

only switch. The choice is stored in the browser under the
`dsh-activity-view.v2` localStorage key.

## How it works

The shipped session browser owns `sidebar.workspaces` as one `single` slot,
header and list together

. Replacing it would also replace search, view options
and add-project. So the plugin does two small

d also replace search, view options
and add-project. So the plugin does two small DOM moves instead:

* the bell is appended to the shipped `headerActions` row and copies the class
of the neighbouring i

con button, so it looks and behaves like the others
* the shipped `listArea` is hidden while the vie

w is on, and a React root with
the activity list mounts beside it

Both anchors are CSS-module local names, which survive build hashes. A
MutationObserver puts the nod

es back when the shell re-renders. Row metrics are
copied from the shipped session rows and use the

hell re-renders. Row metrics are
copied from the shipped session rows and use the same theme tokens.
## Develop

No build step. `client/client.js` is a hand-written loader bundle that the host
serves as a classic
script. Edit it, then reload the page.

Types come from JSDoc, checked by `tsc` against `types.d.ts` (the few host
modules the plugin touche
s) and `@types/react`. Nothing is emitted.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Known limits

* Unread state is process-local in DSH. A reload, a second tab, or a session
that finished while the

page was closed carries no unread mark.
* The DOM seam depends on the shipped `headerActions` and `

listArea` class
names. A DSH release that renames them will break the bell or the list.
* Row sizes

are copied by hand from the shipped CSS. Check them after a DSH
release that restyles the session li

from the shipped CSS. Check them after a DSH
release that restyles the session list.
* English only.
